description: Opus DD unit B27 (Opus X's B3 probe, whose refusal this lifts): Golisopod (Emergency Exit, 76/150 HP) Head Smashes Weak Armor Chansey (Eject Pack; Harden first, so Weak Armor's Defense drop sets the pack's eject flag). The recoil knocks Golisopod out (`faint()` clears its switchFlag) and `runEvent('EmergencyExit')`, which has no HP guard after recoil, flags it again. At AfterMove Chansey's pack sees Golisopod's `switchFlag === true` through `getAllActive()` (the faint is not processed yet) and stays. The fainted Golisopod keeps its flag (`clearVolatile(false)`), so Showdown asks p1 to replace it mid-turn (Snorlax's Harden still queued); Hariyama's switch-in uses the pack (`onAnySwitchIn`) and p2 switches Chansey out for Blissey before Snorlax moves. A crit knocks Chansey out too; a miss (80% accuracy) does nothing.
